notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.8
notes.content:
Bugfixes:
- Fixed the major bug that was preventing the different endings from being triggered if you attempt 2 playthroughs consecutively.
- Fixed the situation where you cannot unlock some achievements if you tried to %100 the game in one sitting.
- Fixed the bug causing achievements to get unlocked all at once, not one by one.
